Hi Priya — thanks for the details and the deadline. Confirming receipt and scope request. High level answers below; I also listed next steps so we can meet your 11/30 compliance window.

Scope clarifications:
- "Prompt inputs": full user-supplied strings and metadata stored in the prompt-indexed store; includes any user key/metadata tagged by your project id.
- "Model outputs": generated text returned by the model and persisted in the prompt-output logs and, where applicable, the KV-cache-backed transcript store.
- "Runtime logs": scheduler/worker traces, token-level logs, and request/response headers kept per our default 90-day retention for sandbox projects. We will treat diagnostic traces as deletable unless explicitly flagged by your team.

Estimated timeline after approval: 48–72 hours for a staged deletion job (manifest generation, targeted wipe, validation), plus 12–24 hours to compile evidence artifacts. If you need same-day turnarounds we can request expedited run with Ops (may affect audit formatting).

Evidence we can provide (pick any combination):
- CSV manifest listing deleted object IDs and timestamps (erase_manifest_YYYYMMDD.csv)
- Signed PDF certificate with job id and hash (erase_proof_YYYYMMDD.pdf)
- Raw audit log slice (redwood-audit-ACME-SBX-71-20281120.tar.gz) — note: tarballs delivered by secure link only.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please confirm acceptance of the scope above and whether you want the full log slice included.
2) Approve the evidence format (CSV + PDF is typical).
3) I will loop Ops (Marissa) to schedule the wipe and provide a runbook + ETA.

I cc'd Ben from your account team so we can surface any commercial constraints.

— Soojin

Hi all — Ops runbook and schedule below. Quoting Priya's original request for context.

> We need to submit a formal deletion request for all prompt inputs, model outputs, and runtime logs associated with our sandbox project (project id: ACME-SBX-71). This covers the period 2027-09-01 through 2028-11-19.

Planned steps (Ops):
1) Manifest generation — list all object IDs for prompt-inputs, outputs, and log segments within the requested time range. ETA: 2 hours. (Will attach CSV)
2) Quarantine & pre-check — ensure no outstanding retention holds or legal holds. ETA: 1 hour.
3) Targeted wipe — execute deletions across prompt-index, output-store, and log-archive. ETA: 6–10 hours depending on shard locality.
4) Verification pass — re-run index queries to ensure zero hits for project id ACME-SBX-71 in the impacted ranges. ETA: 1 hour.
5) Evidence assembly — CSV manifest + signed PDF (job id: RW-ERASE-20281120-88). ETA: 4 hours.

Attachments included: erase_manifest_20281120.csv (sample preview). Full CSV, job logs, and the signed certificate will be uploaded to a presigned S3 link for secure download.

Notes/constraints:
- This action is irreversible for the specified ranges and object sets.
- If Acme requires archival retention beyond our standard retention setting, we need a written exception before step 2.

Scheduling: starting now (2028-11-20 15:30 PST). Target completion and evidence delivery: 2028-11-21 06:00 PST.

Marissa Cole
